summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespace types. In rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__(ref) returns ref.startswith(self) (prefix test); ClosedNamespace.__contains__(ref) returns any(ref == uri for uri in self.__uris.values()) (node-type-aware closed test), inherited by _RDFNamespace. In test/test_namespace.py: added tests to NamespacePrefixTest for prefix membership (positive/negative), SH sh:example, RDFS rdfs:label (True) and rdfs:example (False), RDFS plain-string and Literal negatives, and RDF rdf:type. Imports updated accordingly. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests and doctests are unverified. Container-property (_1) assertion was not added. No commits made.
